answer_1.quote: In contrast, non-literal copying evaluates whether a model generates outputs that, despite differing in surface form (e.g., through paraphrasing), exhibit a high degree of overlap in content.
answer_1.outputs: generated stories, text completions, and answers

answer_2.quote: We compute the ROUGE-L score between the generated output and the next 50 words of the source text... We report the proportion of instances where event overlap exceeds a threshold... Character Overlap is identified through exact matches...

answer_3.quote: We utilize Flan-T5-XL as the attribution model to assess the inclusion of each reference event in the generated story... We use Prometheus-v2 as the evaluator to assess the fluency...

answer_4.quote: To verify that the automatic metrics align with human understanding of event and character reproduction, we conduct a human annotation on a subset of test cases.
answer_4.guideline: We provide the annotators with the generated story along with a list of events and characters, asking them to identify which of these are present in the story.
